artifact: Learning to Feel — acquisition/access measurement fixtures
scope: Deterministic population-probability examples and algebra checks only; no participants, hypothesis-test calibration or power estimate.

checks.name: Normal CDF matches independent standard values
Inverse CDF known quantile and round trips
Population hit/false-alarm inversion recovers d and c
Sensory-baseline and threshold shifts give the same observable rates
More yes reports need not improve discrimination
Joint evidence/threshold shift leaves rates invariant
Sensitivity change is distinct at fixed effective criterion
Pooling heterogeneous rates does not recover average sensitivity
Shared change in all arms cancels in both control contrasts
Averaging controls can hide equality with informative replay
Both control contrasts retain their separate effects
Learning gain without timing dependence is not a timing interaction
Boundary probabilities are rejected rather than silently clipped
